test_cases.title: Toggle Chat Panel Visibility
test_cases.objective: Verify that the toggle button correctly shows and hides the chat panel.
preconditions: ChatBubble component is rendered in the application
No prior panel state is assumed
steps: Locate the toggle button using selector "button.btn.btn-primary.rounded-circle.d-flex.justify-content-center.align-items-center"
Assert that the chat panel (form.p-2) becomes visible
Assert that the chat panel is hidden

mock_strategy.notes: No network calls are involved in this interaction.

pass_when: Panel visibility toggles correctly on each click
fail_when: Panel does not change visibility as expected

test_cases.title: Submit New Chat Message
test_cases.objective: Verify that submitting a new chat message via the form works correctly.
steps: If the panel is hidden, click the toggle button to show it
Locate the input field using selector "input.form-control.form-control-sm.mb-2" and enter the sample message "Hello world"
Locate the submit button using selector "button.btn.btn-primary.btn-sm.w-100" and click it
Mock the ../api/chatApi endpoint to return a successful response
Assert that a success indicator appears (e.g., no error message)

mock_strategy.notes: Mock a successful API response to isolate UI behavior.

pass_when: Message is sent without error and UI reflects success
fail_when: Submission fails or an error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Reject Empty Message Submission
test_cases.objective: Verify that submitting an empty message does not send a chat.
steps: Enter an empty string into the input field
Assert that an appropriate validation message is displayed or no API call occurs

mock_strategy.notes: Verify that no network request is sent when the message is empty.

pass_when: No API request is sent and validation feedback is shown
fail_when: Empty message is sent or no validation occurs
